title: Xiaomi Pad 7 PS2 Emulation Test -  Snapdragon 7 Plus Gen 3 | NetherSX2 🎮
summary: TechStation365 tests eight demanding PS2 games on the Snapdragon 7+ Gen 3 Xiaomi Pad 7, preserving a focused tablet benchmark across action, racing, open-world and sports workloads under NetherSX2.

blocks.text: The twenty-minute video names both the host SoC and emulator, then provides substantial chapters for Black, God of War II, two Need for Speed titles, Shadow of the Colossus, Resident Evil 4, GTA San Andreas and FIFA 14. That selection is more informative than eight similar fighters because it exercises different CPU, graphics and streaming pressures. The tablet form also offers a distinct thermal envelope and display context from compact phones using the same broad Android software stack.

The notes do not state the NetherSX2 build, renderer, internal resolution, driver, memory capacity, room temperature or whether recording occurs on-device. The creator also comments that Android PS2 development had nearly stopped, a time-bound opinion rather than a technical measurement. Evaluate speed and visual correctness from each named scene, not the thumbnail or chipset label. For comparison, reproduce current builds with fixed settings and monitor sustained clocks beyond the short chapter, especially before attributing a game fault to Snapdragon 7+ Gen 3.
